"""Int leaf ranges, pipes, flag attestation, filtering precedence."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

def run_campaign(campaign):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(campaign).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

types = [
    {"name": "I20", "kind": "int", "bits": 20},
    {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "Ch", "kind": "char"},
]
# entry e1: params n: I20, c: Ch; result: Flag; requires: n < 100
#   pipes: target e1, filter f1 bound {fn: n}; f1 requires fn > 50 (bool result)
#   f1 has own pipe: target f1, filter f2 bound {f2n: fn}; f2 requires f2n != 7
e1 = {"name": "e1", "params": [["n", "I20"], ["c", "Ch"]], "result": ["res", "Flag"],
      "requires": ["lt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "I20", 100]]}
f1 = {"name": "f1", "params": [["fn", "I20"]], "result": ["fr", "Flag"],
      "requires": ["gt", ["var", "fn"], ["const", "I20", 50]]}
f2 = {"name": "f2", "params": [["f2n", "I20"]], "result": ["f2r", "Flag"],
      "requires": ["ne", ["var", "f2n"], ["const", "I20", 7]]}
pipes = [
    {"target": "e1", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"fn": "n"}},
    {"target": "f1", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"f2n": "fn"}},
]
# layout: n x0 (width 4), c x1 (1), res x2 (1), flag x3 -> variables 4
def objs(n, c, res, flagv):
    return [("x0", le(n, 4)), ("x1", le(c, 1)), ("x2", le(res, 1)), ("x3", le(flagv, 1))]

def mk(objects):
    return {"entry": "e1", "ktest": b64(ktest(objects))}

runs = [
    mk(objs(60, 65, 0, 0)),   # valid: filters accept, pred true -> READY
    mk(objs(60, 65, 1, 1)),   # flag=1 but filters accept -> INVALID (attestation)
    mk(objs(30, 65, 0, 1)),   # f1 rejects (30<=50); flag=1 consistent -> FILTERED
    mk(objs(30, 65, 0, 0)),   # f1 rejects, flag=0 -> INVALID (attestation; even though pred would reject too? 30<100 pred true, filter false)
    mk(objs(150, 65, 0, 0)),  # pred false (150>=100), filters accept (150>50, !=7), flag 0 -> FILTERED
    mk(objs(150, 65, 0, 1)),  # pred false, flag mismatch -> INVALID (attestation precedes FILTERED)
    mk(objs(60, 65, 0, 0)),   # dup of run 0
    mk(objs(7, 65, 0, 1)),    # n=7: f2 rejects (7==7) -> not accept; flag=1 consistent -> FILTERED
    mk(objs(7, 65, 0, 0)),    # f2 rejects, flag=0 -> INVALID
    mk(objs(1 << 20, 65, 0, 0)),  # int padding bits -> INVALID (leaf range)
]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [e1, f1, f2], "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["e1"], "machine": None, "runs": runs}
out = run_campaign(campaign)
statuses = [r['status'] for r in out['records']]
exp = ['READY', 'INVALID_TEST', 'FILTERED', 'INVALID_TEST', 'FILTERED',
       'INVALID_TEST', 'DUPLICATE', 'FILTERED', 'INVALID_TEST', 'INVALID_TEST']
assert statuses == exp, (statuses, exp)
plan = out['plans'][0]
assert plan['flag'] == 'x3', plan['flag']
assert plan['variables'] == 4, plan['variables']
assert plan['modules'] == ['e1', 'f1', 'f2'], plan['modules']  # prereqs before e1; f2 before f1
assert plan['types'] == [], plan['types']
assert out['corpus'][0]['witnesses'] == [0, 6]
assert out['corpus'][0]['inputs'] == {"n": 60, "c": "A"}
# filters as unrelated modules absent from other entries' plans; second entry with no pipes:
e2 = {"name": "e2", "params": [["n", "I20"]], "result": ["res", "Flag"], "requires": None}
campaign2 = dict(campaign)
campaign2['modules'] = [e1, f1, f2, e2]
campaign2['entries'] = ["e1", "e2"]
campaign2['runs'] = [{"entry": "e2", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", le(3, 4)), ("x1", le(1, 1))]))}]
out2 = run_campaign(campaign2)
p2 = out2['plans'][1]
assert p2['modules'] == ['e2'], p2['modules']
assert p2['flag'] is None and p2['variables'] == 2
assert out2['records'] == [{'status': 'READY', 'case': 0, 'model_result': True}]
print("T3 OK")
